title: Par native recovery checkpoint and binary codec contract

codec.length_encoding: unsigned 64-bit >Q; bytes for strings/integers, element count for containers

tags.l: length followed by recursively typed list items
tags.u: length followed by recursively typed tuple items
tags.o: entry count followed by recursively typed string-key/value pairs; sorted string keys

codec.float_bits: Signed zero and NaN payload bits preserved. No Decimal, pickle or implicit numeric conversion.
codec.integrity: External receipt SHA256 binds entire .bin bytes; receipt is in turn bound by the batch/advance ledger or externally supplied SHA.

required_root_paths.count: integer original source row count, not elapsed calendar days
required_root_paths.context: original source context; date updated only to actual source tail
required_root_paths.source_binding: source reference/hash/basis and physical date object
required_root_paths.code_binding: original latest109/dependency/source pins plus candidate implementation SHA256 object
required_root_paths.original_rows: complete original-normalized source rows, retained until detector dependency closure is proven
required_root_paths.component109: authenticated original foundation/N state plus current native detector result
required_root_paths.latest109: null at reused seed when original109 output remains externally referenced; current109 object after a true append
required_root_paths.detector_dependency_closed: false; no minimal bounded detector-state claim
required_root_paths.all109_compatibility_certified: false; scoped verification receipts are separate

origin_dependent_paths.environment_binding: observed local runtime for reused-original bulk products; mother/oracle products are bound by validation/ENVIRONMENT_BINDING.json
origin_dependent_paths.original_state51: unchanged authenticated original Decimal51 state; its decimal strings are never substituted for native float64 accumulators
origin_dependent_paths.initialization_driver_sha256: bootstrap.py SHA for bulk reuse initialization
origin_dependent_paths.daily_source_refs: ordered original child-bundle references for actual appended dates

native_state_paths.native_state.binding: original source bindings, native core SHA, initialized numeric prefix SHA
native_state_paths.native_state.first_date: YYYYMMDD or null before first append
native_state_paths.native_state.last_date: YYYYMMDD or null before first append
native_state_paths.native_state.pre_close: last source close or null; no displayed-value inference
native_state_paths.native_state.accumulators.ema10_layer1: unrounded binary64 or null before initialization
native_state_paths.native_state.accumulators.ema10_layer2: unrounded binary64 or null before initialization
native_state_paths.native_state.accumulators.brick_sma4: unrounded binary64 or null before four-bar source window
native_state_paths.native_state.accumulators.brick_sma6_1: unrounded binary64 or null before four-bar source window
native_state_paths.native_state.accumulators.brick_sma6_2: unrounded binary64 or null before four-bar source window
native_state_paths.native_state.validity.input_prefix: sticky bool; invalid native full prefix is not reset to valid
native_state_paths.native_state.validity.kdj_prefix: bool; flat denominator validity retained within native evaluated prefix
native_state_paths.native_state.validity.brick_prefix: bool; flat denominator validity retained within native evaluated prefix
native_state_paths.native_state.raw_prefix: all normalized numeric rows; source O/H/L/C/V/pre_close/pct plus bound MA60/yellow references; complete history retained
native_state_paths.native_state.sequences.white: array<source integer0|binary64|null>, original round2 output after10 bars
native_state_paths.native_state.sequences.yellow: array<source integer0|binary64|null>, original round2 output after114 bars
native_state_paths.native_state.sequences.kdj: array<tuple(K,D,J)|null>; source integer50 warmup or rounded binary64 output
native_state_paths.native_state.sequences.brick: array<source integer0|binary64|null>, mature original round2 brick values

component_state_paths.component109.n_score: count,last_date,complete swings/ambiguous/invalid/post_ambiguity arrays and validity_tail10; actual original state reused
component_state_paths.component109.native_latest: original57-field native object, same-call raw event objects and rounded K/D/J/BBI references; never treated as hidden recurrence state

rolling_and_sticky_dependencies.windows: Keep full raw prefix. Original last4/9/24/114 windows and original summation order are used; no rolling-sum algebra substitution.
rolling_and_sticky_dependencies.brick_sticky: Complete mature brick history plus warmup/null positions retained. Original KB8 derives run origin, previous run and flip/action from this sequence; no guessed scalar count or censored warmup origin.
rolling_and_sticky_dependencies.detectors: Exact original detector bodies run for the current row using stored primitive prefixes. Original separately seeded bounded sliced-window calls remain original and are counted. Unproven unbounded primitive fallback is rejected.
rolling_and_sticky_dependencies.invalid_prefix: Original native full-prefix invalidity remains invalid/UNKNOWN. Invalid-source datasets are not repaired, zero-filled or restarted from later valid rows. No real invalid-source acceptance sample is certified by the valid mother canaries.

bindings_and_reuse.source: Exact original package/member/continuation hashes, original catalog and source-normalizer SHA; source basis and physical last date
bindings_and_reuse.candidate: Kernel original pins and 3 native implementation SHAs; initializer/source-loader identities checked before reuse
bindings_and_reuse.runtime: Python/numpy/pandas/pyarrow/platform recorded. Installation absolute paths are provenance, not numerical identity. Original Cloud fixed runtime remains UNKNOWN.
bindings_and_reuse.parent: Original child reference SHA, state51 parent-state SHA, symbol, count+1, asof and unchanged source-basis keys checked before a daily step; returned state boundaries checked before saving
bindings_and_reuse.resume: Externally bound receipt and state SHA, current kernel/source/runtime and complete requested advance-prefix identity; already completed initialization is reused

limitations: Same-source closed history is required; Mac V4 history is not a substitute.
A mother ending20261026 is never labeled20261109.
Actual saved Par109 comparison covers the measured symbols/dates only; cross-machine generalization remains CANNOT_CONFIRM.
PIT, absolute volume units, adjustment/suspension validity and original Cloud runtime are not inferred from source SHA.
No native child or authenticated same-source coordinate conversion for20261111/12 means those dates remain UNKNOWN, not filled.
All products remain isolated research recovery candidates; no deployment, trading or model admission.
